body.statement: The positive source parent contexts specified by \(Ictx\), source compatibility, and type sharing uniquely recover every row in \(K\). Replaying the truncated factorization of \(S\), \(G\), \(rho\), \(a\), and \(B\) yields \(F\in\mathbb Q[q]\). For every \(M\in Mone\), there is one scalar \(q_M\in[0,1]\) such that \(Q(M)=F(q_M)\); conversely, substituting any shared row \((1-q_0,q_0)\) yields \(F(q_0)\). The degree \(D\) is at most the maximum number of target nodes that can use \(rstar\) in one assignment.
body.justification: This isolates the single structural degree of freedom without untying its repeated relational occurrences.
body.gap: Zhang, Tian, and Bareinboim give a general polynomial program; the diagonal one-row collapse for a type-shared relational mechanism is not stated there.
body.consumer: It converts the unsupported N3 mechanism row into an explicit target polynomial that can be bounded rather than represented by one fitted RNCM value.
